killedBy: capture.mjs: the aria object each measured element carries (issue #937) omits the aria object for an element with none of the nine, and records nothing unlisted
capture.mjs: the aria object each measured element carries (issue #937) writes the keys in the list's order and puts aria before style
why: Writes an aria key on every measured element, empty or not. The committed baseline then grows an "aria": {} block on every element without attributes, which makes the whole-baseline accept diff noisy, and an element that lost all its attributes reads as a changed object rather than the plain absence a reviewer scans for.
